description: For every actual quantifier-free scoped matrix, the executable existential matrix test accepts exactly when its actual existentially quantified sentence has a nonempty model.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.existentialMatrixTest_correct.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  [(n : ℕ) → DecidableEq (L.Functions n)] [(n : ℕ) → DecidableEq (L.Relations n)] {n : ℕ} (A : L.BoundedFormula Empty n)
  (hA : A.IsQF) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.existentialMatrixTest A = true ↔
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.GroundHasModel A.exs
